hero_subhead: Panels, fireside chats and Q&A nights in the Theatre at Den 1880 — elevated bleacher seating for up to 100 guests, so every seat faces the conversation.
band_intro: A good panel needs a room that pulls the audience in. The Theatre's elevated bleacher seating puts every guest close to the stage, the 16-foot video wall carries your slides or titles, and wireless mics keep the conversation moving — on stage and from the floor. And when the talk ends, the room opens into the Lobby Bar for a reception with up to 140 guests.
spec_subhead: The AV and the seating are part of the room, so your event starts with the hard parts done.
cta_headline: Put Your Panel On A Real Stage
cta_subhead: Tell us your date, your speakers and your audience size. Our events team replies within one business day.
